svg.title: One question, cut into tokens
svg.desc: A question about strawberry, cut into its tokens by OpenAI's o200k_base tokenizer. Each word after the first is marked with the space in front of it. The token for strawberry, with its space, has one number. Without the space, the word splits into three pieces.

g.text: How many r's are in strawberry?
